naslov: Denver plays Houston, seeks 4th straight road win
tekst:
Denver Nuggets (5-3, ninth in the Western Conference) vs. Houston Rockets (7-3, sixth in the Western Conference)
              Houston; Monday, 8:30 p.m. EST
              BOTTOM LINE: Denver will try to keep its three-game road win streak alive when the Nuggets face Houston.
              Houston went 52-30 overall, 29-23 in Western Conference play and 30-11 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Rockets averaged 25.4 assists per game on 43.0 made field goals last season.
              Denver went 54-28 overall and 36-16 in Western Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Nuggets averaged 122.1 points per game last season, 20.8 on free throws and 42.6 from 3-point range.
              INJURIES: Rockets: Clint Capela: out (ankle), Steven Adams: out (calf).
              Nuggets: Julian Strawther: out (knee).
